platform_outcome.triager_reason_verbatim: The original report was evaluated and closed as informative, indicating that the program investigated and determined the credential has no impact. The account was associated with a former employee and cannot access any program data.
platform_outcome.lesson: Third negative disposition in a row; reinforces toolsforhumanity. trufflehog Verified=true (live SauceLabs issuer check) again did NOT mean impact — the account was an orphaned former-employee subaccount with no data access. THREE missed signals: (1) the secret lived in a TEST-FIXTURE path (test/utils/keys.js) — a CI/test credential by location; Verified=true wrongly overrode the test-path discount the loop already applies to noseyparker hits. (2) git-history-only (deleted from HEAD) + ~12-year age in a flagship public repo (elasticsearch-js) = very high duplicate prior AND likely-orphaned-account prior. (3) impact was speculative ('past test runs MAY have recorded sensitive data', 'Sauce Connect pivot IF configured') — same inflation pattern as #3742794. This is exactly the pattern the later dynatrace engagement (2026-05-30) articulated as a non-finding ('history-only secret needing active third-party infra access to PoC') but no rule existed yet. See [[feedback-rpc-key-low-impact]] and rule-secret_hunter-history_only_test_fixture_low_impact-9d2e1.
